chunks: Yahya ibn Zayd ibn al-Abbas ibn al-Walid al-Bazzaz in Kufa narrated to us, saying: His uncle Ali ibn al-Abbas narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Bishr ibn Khalid al-Abdi narrated to us, saying: Amr ibn Khalid narrated to us, saying: Abu Hamzah al-Thumali narrated to us, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them), saying:
Good speech enriches wealth, increases sustenance, delays death, creates love among family members, and causes entry into Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of good speech in Islam according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, this narration from Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin) underscores the transformative power of *al-qawl al-hasan* (good speech) as a means of spiritual purification and worldly blessing. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between ethical conduct and divine favor, where eloquent and kind words serve as a catalyst for increased rizq, longevity, and familial harmony, ultimately culminating in eternal success in Paradise.
